description: Check local campaign admission across an actual pending snapshot and completion of an older normal apply batch, preserving three fixed phase observations and a post-completion control.

harness.description: TestAssuranceSnapshotCampaignBarrier; actual Bootstrap/Campaign/Propose, application data snapshot, compaction, automatic replication fallback and FIFO storage responses.
semantic_changes: MemoryStorage models a no-crash stable-storage boundary.
Deterministic transport, a temporary follower partition and held local work replace production scheduling.
Public BasicStatus supplies the checked role and term; internal pending queues belong to the driver, not modified protocol internals.

legality.derivation: Bootstrap three empty MemoryStorage-backed RawNodes and elect node 1 through actual messages. Drain all bootstrap configuration and the leader no-op. Hold node 3 apply work only while a normal proposal reaches index 5. Partition node 3, commit/apply two more proposals on nodes 1/2, create a snapshot from the actual leader application data and last returned ConfState at index 7, then compact. Reconnect with one leader heartbeat; process actual probe rejections and non-snapshot FIFO append work until automatic MsgSnap reaches node 3. Snapshot index exceeds its stored last index 5, preventing matching-prefix fast-forward. Hold the snapshot queue head. First Campaign runs with old apply still held; second follows completion of that actual normal apply batch; third follows snapshot storage/application and delivery of its actual attached response. Snapshot transport completion is reported through RawNode.ReportSnapshot. The scheduler never skips a blocked snapshot head. It drains a fixed permitted-work schedule with a 10000-step construction limit, independent of the comparison. No raft state or network message is assigned.
legality.applicability: Single goroutine serializes RawNode calls. MemoryStorage substitutes for durable media only in a no-crash setting. Snapshot Data contains the actual accumulated normal-entry state and is installed by decoding that payload. The snapshot installation deliberately follows earlier normal application, avoiding the unresolved configuration ordering branch.
alternatives: Holding all append work before snapshot delivery blocks the real rejection path; failed exploration 9a5cebc41e534ebab825feb8e52e1d62 demonstrated this construction mistake.
Permitting non-snapshot FIFO work before holding the snapshot reached the intended history in exploration b24b00617a78411f8e23ab629496c70d; that exploration is not formal property Evidence.

grounding.derivation: For each request/phase/node/snapshot identity, campaign_admitted records the already delivered snapshot and invocation context. campaign_observed is emitted immediately after the synchronous Campaign call. campaign_started derives from public BasicStatus term increase or candidate/pre-candidate/leader role, retaining raw before/after term and role. snapshot_completed is an independent driver ledger set only after actual snapshot installation and subsequent Step delivery of its matching attached MsgStorageAppendResp, not from promotable or unstable.snapshot. The one-way comparison is campaign_started implies snapshot_completed. The post-completion checkpoint is a permitted control, not an eventual-election oracle.
grounding.applicability: Three separately correlated synchronous calls in one actual history. No unrelated message dispatch occurs between before/after status reads. No result is filtered by the expected property value.
alternatives: A blocked campaign is allowed while work is pending.
A blocked post-completion campaign would not itself violate this necessity condition.

observable_properties.description: An explicit Campaign starts an election only after the matching full snapshot completion has been consumed. Earlier application completion cannot substitute for snapshot completion.

uncertainties: This checks a source-defined local admission responsibility, not overall election safety or client linearizability.
Only a single full snapshot, fixed membership and normal-entry older batch are covered.
MemoryStorage completion is not physical crash durability evidence.
